shouldFix.title: The newly asserted D-002 platform vocabulary is incomplete against D-002's own bytes - it drops the architecture dimension D-002 enumerates - and the omission is load-bearing because validation rejects any token outside it
shouldFix.subjectEvidence: validatedPlatformSets.source is new at v9 and states that each identity's platform set is 'validated against the D-002 slice-1 vocabulary (currently linux, macOS; Windows absent until that platform enters)'. The live D-002 entry, measured by this reviewer at COORD 0833973f… (the digest /reMeasurementAtV9 itself records), reads: '**Platforms:** macOS (arm64, x86_64) and Linux (x86_64, arm64). Windows deferred with explicit disposition.' D-002 enumerates two operating systems each with two architectures; v9 enumerates two bare OS tokens and drops the architectures entirely. It also lowercases D-002's 'Linux' to 'linux'. validation makes the enumeration operative rather than descriptive: 'A platform token not in the D-002 vocabulary, an empty set, or a conflicting pair of sets is invalid' - and invalid is AMBIGUOUS-REFUSE-ONLY under step 3.
shouldFix.counterexample: Two horns, and the artifact does not choose between them. (a) A DR-103 component manifest declares its platforms at D-002's stated granularity - macOS-arm64, macOS-x86_64, Linux-x86_64, Linux-arm64. Under validation as written none of those tokens is in the vocabulary {linux, macOS}, so every set is invalid, every identity is AMBIGUOUS-REFUSE-ONLY, and the selector refuses permanently. That is fail-closed deadlock. (b) The harness instead reads the vocabulary literally and builds effectivePlatformAxis over two OS tokens. The corpus platform axis then carries two values where D-002 names four, halving the component x role x platform x changeClass domain and dropping arch coverage that D-002 explicitly recorded - under-coverage of the 'component/language/platform matrix' the live DR-G16 acceptance cell requires, with the fixtureDomainBasis digest blessing the smaller domain as complete.
shouldFix.governingMeasurement: Every version from v1 through v8 referred to 'the D-002 slice-1 vocabulary' by reference and never enumerated it, which was correct and defect-free - the vocabulary is D-002's to fix and this row consumes it. v9 is the first to enumerate, and the enumeration is where the mismatch enters. The live DR-G16 constraint cell 'platform scope follows component manifest' and componentLane.platforms both keep platform scope with the manifest and D-002, not with this artifact.
shouldFix.impact: This row does not own the slice-1 platform vocabulary, and the artifact says so everywhere else. Restating another decision's content inside a load-bearing validation rule creates a place for the two to diverge, and they have already diverged on first use. Horn (a) is fail-closed and horn (b) is a coverage shortfall, so this is not an under-selection escape and not a blocker - but one of the two is live depending on a DR-103 manifest-granularity question this row also does not own.
shouldFix.requiredRepair: Revert to reference: have validation read 'validated against the D-002 slice-1 platform vocabulary as recorded in the adopted D-002 entry' with no inline list, which is what v1-v8 did and what keeps this row from restating a decision it does not own. systemicObservation: Fourth consecutive candidate with no blocker, and the two v8 findings were repaired more completely than asked - ROLELESS-NA got the full three-case axis definition rather than the minimum carve-out, and validatedPlatformSets was promoted to a full record member rather than merely named. The three surviving findings share a shape worth naming, because it differs from the enumeration drift that dominated v5 through v8. Each is a case where the artifact restated something it does not own, or annotated a design that worked without the annotation. V9-S1 restates D-002's platform vocabulary inside a validation rule and gets it wrong on first use; V9-S2 appends a generation-specific parenthetical to a locator that was correct precisely because it named no generation; V9-S3 drops the re-verification that converts an inherited whole-document pin into a defensible claim. The lesson the chain has already learned for enumerations - keep exactly one, and have everything else refer to it - applies here to external facts: refer to the owning decision, do not copy it. The two authoring-time greps from v5 and v7 would not have caught any of these; a third check would catch all three, which is to ask of every clause added this cycle whether it restates a fact owned by another row or another decision, and if so whether it is carried verbatim with a digest the way registerRowQuoted and ciTextCarriedVerbatim already are.
verdictBasis: Zero blockers and three SHOULD-FIX findings; the dispatch admits ACCEPT only at zero and zero. All five claimed repairs are real and verified against the subject's bytes, and every predecessor verdict record is certified directly against frozen bytes. None of the three findings is an under-selection escape: V9-S1 is fail-closed on one horn and a coverage shortfall on the other, V9-S2 and V9-S3 are provenance defects with the underlying facts independently confirmed correct.
verdictStatement: v9 answers both v8 reviews and does so more thoroughly than the findings required. The role axis is now a closed three-case definition that can never be empty, ROLELESS-NA is a lawful sentinel stated as such in four clauses and excluded by name from the missing-applicability class, validated platform sets are promoted to a full ownership-record member with previous/current comparison that forecloses a second live manifest read, ID-DEP-C6 enumerates all six record members and ID-DEP-C7 routes the DR-118 role map, G16-13 binds the fixture-domain digest, and G16-14's scope against deferred slots is settled in both directions. The roster is closed at zero off-roster paths and the method adds a standing rule that correctly demotes the prior LIVE block. What blocks acceptance is a new habit rather than an old one: three clauses restate or annotate something this row does not own. The artifact now enumerates D-002's slice-1 platform vocabulary inline as 'linux, macOS' where the adopted D-002 entry reads 'macOS (arm64, x86_64) and Linux (x86_64, arm64)', and because validation rejects any token outside that list the omission either refuses every manifest that uses D-002's actual granularity or halves the platform axis of the matrix DR-G16 requires. Both live-pin locators still append '(reMeasurementAtV8)' to the standing-based formulation that was designed to be generation-independent, and v9 stamps that block HISTORICAL-AT-V8. And the LIVE block has now gone two generations without re-verifying the D-002 named properties that are the inherited COORD pin's only warrant - which is the discipline that would have caught the platform-vocabulary error. Every pin and property this reviewer checked independently is correct in fact. DR-121 remains OPEN; DR-G16 remains PROPOSED, not QUALIFIED; no DR is marked SATISFIED.
authorityOfThisVerdict: This verdict is a reviewer opinion recorded for coordinator disposition. It applies nothing, edits no subject, marks no DR SATISFIED, marks no gate QUALIFIED, authorizes no implementation, chooses no CI vendor, mints no D-096 (A) grant, and does not touch docs/v2/architecture/08-decision-and-readiness-register.md or docs/coop/COORDINATOR-DECISIONS.md. It did not edit the review prompt it was given.
coordinatorNote: A v10 needs one path that has not been rostered since v8 - /recordedInputs - plus /selector/ownershipRecord, /g16Tests/corpus and /reMeasurementAtV9, all already rostered. Only V9-S1 needs a decision rather than an edit, and it is a scoping decision the coordinator should make: whether this row may restate the D-002 platform vocabulary at all. The safe answer is no - refer to D-002 and let it own its own list, which is what v1 through v8 did without defect. If the answer is yes, the vocabulary must be carried verbatim with its source digest under the same discipline registerRowQuoted and ciTextCarriedVerbatim already use, and the OS-versus-OS-plus-architecture granularity must be stated because the corpus axis size depends on it. Two process notes. First, the frozen-predecessor-readable convention has now paid off in five consecutive cycles and let this verdict certify all nine predecessor records. Second, V9-S3 is worth treating as a standing requirement rather than a one-time fix: every generation's LIVE block should re-verify the named properties, because that is the only thing keeping a whole-document pin that moves on every coordinator append from becoming an unwarranted assertion, and this cycle shows what slips through when it lapses.
